projects.name: GDOT STIP Projects - STIP Project Type (GDOT ArcGIS Online)
projects.notes: PARTIAL AND DATED. Hosted in GDOT's ArcGIS Online organization; only 259 projects, and the data was last edited 2023-06-16 (schema touched 2026-01-15), so it looks like the mapped subset of an earlier STIP rather than the current FY27-30 one. PROJECT_ID is the GDOT PI number. PROJECT_TY = New Construction / Reconstruction/Rehabilitation / Replacement / Safety. STATUS: 'Construction Work Program' = programmed in the near-term work program, 'Long Range Program' = later years. Useful extra: 'PreParcelCount' (20 in the sample) appears to be GDOT's preliminary count of parcels affected; meaning not documented on the service. Cost, phase and year are not on the layer: they are in table 5 'Financials' of the same service (https://services3.arcgis.com/6RaeG1zfsIoM9Lze/arcgis/rest/services/STIP_Projects/FeatureServer/5, 1,176 rows: PINumber, PropYear, Phase e.g. 'ROW', FundCode, TotalAmt, FedAmt, StAmt, OthAmt), joined PINumber = PROJECT_ID; rows with Phase = 'ROW' give the right-of-way year and amount. Layer 1 of the service is the same projects for search (307 records). GDOT's main project system (GeoPI, https://rnhp.dot.ga.gov/hosting/rest/services/GEOPI_APP/MapServer and .../STIP/STIP_Program_Type/FeatureServer) is the full, current source, but that server rejected every automated request with a firewall 'Request Rejected' page, so it is NOT verified and may not be usable by an automated reader.

projects.name: Atlanta Regional Commission Metropolitan Transportation Plan - Lines (Atlanta region only)
projects.notes: Not statewide: the Atlanta MPO's TIP and long-range plan (about 20 counties), maintained (edited October 2026). STATUS 'Programmed' = in the TIP, 'Long Range' = plan years, 'Completed' = done (exclude). GDOTPI holds the matching GDOT PI number(s); Exist_Lane / Prop_Lanes show widening; SPONSOR; Fact_Sheet_Link is a PDF per project. No cost or date fields. Layer 0 of the same service is the point projects (134 records, same fields) and layer 2 polygons.

parcels_counties.notes: Fulton County tax parcels (ArcGIS Online). OwnerAddr2 holds city, state and ZIP in one string. TaxYear was 2027 in the sample. No value field. maxRecordCount 1000.

Gwinnett County GIS 'FYT_Owner_Data' (parcels joined to owner data). Also OWNER2, LOCCITY, LOCZIP, LANDVAL1, DWLGVAL1, LEGALAC, ZONING, GRANTOR1-3. The county's main layer Property_and_Tax/FeatureServer/0 has NO owner fields; use this one.

Cobb County's own server. OWNER_NAM2 is the second owner. FMV_LAND / FMV_BLDG / FMV_TOTAL are fair market values, ASV_* assessed. 278,712 of the records have an owner name (the rest are right-of-way and similar polygons with PIN '000'). maxRecordCount 1000.

Savannah Area GIS (SAGIS) 'Parcel Digest 2025'. The layer number is one per year (26 = 2024, 27 = 2025), so a 2026 digest will be a new layer id. Also Owner2, FMV_Land, FMV_Building, Property_Use, Sale_Price, Legal_Description.

summary: Projects: no complete current statewide GDOT layer could be verified (GDOT's own server blocks automated requests; the reachable GDOT STIP layer is small and dated; ARC covers the Atlanta region). Parcels: no statewide layer; Fulton, Gwinnett, Cobb and Chatham county layers with owner and mailing address are verified; DeKalb publishes no owner names.
parcels_statewide_reason: No free statewide Georgia parcel layer with owner names was found (ArcGIS Online catalog search returned none; Georgia parcels are published county by county).
parcels_counties_not_found: DeKalb: the county's Tax_Parcels_2025 layer (https://services2.arcgis.com/IxVN2oUE9EYLSnPE/arcgis/rest/services/Tax_Parcels_2025/FeatureServer/0, fetched) has parcel id and values but no owner fields.
